description: Render a basic yellow star with 500 particles using the manim-astronomy Star mobject — mimics a sun-like stellar object.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_Astronomy import Star

class StarBasicYellow(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        star = Star(
            radius=0.5,
            num_of_particles=500,
            size_of_particle=0.005,
            colors=[YELLOW],
        )
        star.move_to(ORIGIN)
        self.add(star)
        self.wait(0.5)
